observations: Three manual hydraulic pallet jacks are shown in a warehouse or yard setting.
The jacks have yellow painted metal forks and black handles.
The forks show significant surface rust and wear, particularly on the lower sections.
The hydraulic rams and the triangular base plates are visible.
A watermark 'PREYE DOUGLAS77' is present on the image.
The photo is taken from a low angle, showing the underside of the jacks.

claims.evidence: The capacity rating is not visible on the jacks in the photo.
The design with hand-operated levers and no power unit confirms this.
The forks and handles are characteristic of this type of industrial equipment.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The hydraulic rams may be leaking or seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the jacks being operated to lift a pallet.

risks.risk: The forks may be bent or have internal structural damage.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the forks from the side and top.

risks.risk: The base plates may be cracked or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the base plates and the ground contact points.

proof_requests: Photo of the capacity rating plate (usually on the side of the base plate).
Video of the jacks being used to lift a pallet.
Close-up photos of the forks and base plates to check for cracks or severe rust.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
